end.summary:
Identified standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines, including in a why question.
Practised telling straight lines from curved lines; a new-situation check is still needed.
Practised finding line types in letters and objects; some examples were identified and some need checking next time.
Mixed up line directions in one figure and letter examples; later identified the figure’s lines and the slide and table lines.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines, straight versus curved lines, and finding these lines in letters and objects. Om used reasons such as “no bend” and described the flagpole, bangle, table, and slide; they corrected the figure mix-up later, while letter examples still need another check. At home, ask Om to point out one standing, sleeping, slanting, and curved line in three everyday objects and explain why.
